title: Detailed cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main cheese wedge body - warm golden yellow -->
  <path d='M18 72 L18 40 L78 58 L78 82 Z' fill='#F2C64B'/>
  
  <!-- Top face of wedge - brighter yellow for contrast -->
  <path d='M18 40 L58 24 L78 58 Z' fill='#FFD966'/>
  
  <!-- Right side face - slightly darker golden -->
  <path d='M58 24 L78 58 L78 82 Z' fill='#E0A82E'/>
  
  <!-- Front face - medium yellow -->
  <path d='M18 40 L18 72 L78 82 L78 58 Z' fill='#F2C64B'/>
  
  <!-- Top face highlight edge -->
  <path d='M18 40 L58 24 L78 58' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2B0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  
  <!-- Left edge highlight -->
  <path d='M18 40 L18 72' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom edge of front face lighter -->
  <path d='M18 72 L78 82' fill='none' stroke='#F7DA7A' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Right edge of front face -->
  <path d='M78 58 L78 82' fill='none' stroke='#D49A24' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Back edge of side face -->
  <path d='M58 24 L78 58' fill='none' stroke='#D49A24' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 1 on top face -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#D49A24' transform='rotate(-8 40 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='37' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#B87D1A' transform='rotate(-8 40 37)'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 2 on top face - smaller -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='45' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#D49A24' transform='rotate(-8 55 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='44.2' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#B87D1A' transform='rotate(-8 55 44.2)'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 3 on front face -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#B87D1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='57' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#9A6512'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 4 on front face - small -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='64' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#B87D1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='63.2' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#9A6512'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 5 on front face - tiny -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#B87D1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='51.4' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#9A6512'/>
  
  <!-- Hole 6 on side face -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='66' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C48E20'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='65.2' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#A87116'/>
  
  <!-- Hole on top face near back -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#D49A24' transform='rotate(-8 62 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='35.3' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#B87D1A' transform='rotate(-8 62 35.3)'/>
  
  <!-- Cheese texture dots on front face -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='68' r='1.2' fill='#E0A82E'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='55' r='1' fill='#E0A82E'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='1' fill='#E0A82E'/>
  
  <!-- Top face inner highlight sheen -->
  <path d='M25 42 L50 31 L70 55' fill='none' stroke='#FFF8D0' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Front face subtle vertical highlight -->
  <path d='M22 44 L22 70' fill='none' stroke='#F7DA7A' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
